title: Dry/moist whole pairs operate on a shared amount frame
summary: GDT760 observes cheor and sheor in exact amount slots under the same s/or/ar and value-II/III contexts. A speculative functional hypothesis is that the complete words are alternative state operators over one amount-bearing frame, rather than unrelated material nouns.

design.mechanism: state operator over shared amount frame
design.unit: complete cheor/sheor whole in an exact amount expression with independently coded amount head and value
design.contrast: dry/moist forms alter a shared amount-frame state versus each whole names an unrelated material noun
design.prediction: Across held amount frames, replacing cheor with sheor should preserve amount-head/value syntax while changing only the state slot; unrelated-noun analysis predicts independent attachment or slot behavior.
design.countermodel: The apparent shared frame may be a template that accepts unrelated nouns, and the dry/moist contrast may be an analyst gloss rather than an observed operator.
design.falsifier: Held cheor/sheor occurrences fail to preserve the amount frame under a predeclared state substitution, or independent noun-role coding explains them equally without a state slot.
design.principal_risk: GDT760 calls these working candidates and explicitly says water and wine remain rivals; no lexical identity is established.
design.related: Near GDT760/GDT762/GDT761, but asks a substitutional operator question over exact amount frames rather than selecting a medium, side attachment, or global state gloss.

source_evidence.quote:
cheor und sheor sind nun das beste kleine Inhaltsparadigma:

| Ganzwort | Mengenanschlüsse | globale exakte Vorkommen | Arbeitswert |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| cheor | 3 auf 3 Seiten | 56 | trockener Drogenteil |
| sheor | 3 auf 3 Seiten | 31 | feuchter Drogenteil |

Beide stehen in exakten Mengenplätzen, gemeinsam unter s, or und ar sowie bei
Wert II und III. Damit wird der Trocken/Feucht-Gegensatz praktisch nützlich:
Die Formen sind nicht nur abstrakte Zustandsfelder, sondern Kandidaten für
zähl- oder wägbare Drogenteile.
